title: AIGAMEDEV logo + banner competition come get involved
author: Glittering-Pie6039
selftext:
Hey all RedPando here from the Discord side of things.

We are currently running a **logo and banner competition** over in the AIGAMEDEV Discord and there have already got a few entires.

We wanted to bring the server and reddit up to date with the changes that have been made over the past few months and with new things coming (see my update in the pinned post) part of that was replacing the current logo with something built and voted for **by you**.

The comp is running for another few weeks before votng begins and WE WANT YOU all to contribute.

If you're into game dev, design, art, AI image tools, traditional design or just fancy having a go, come join the Discord and check the competition out.

**Entries and voting close on 12th September.**

The winner is planned to be announced on **21st September**.

Even if you don't want to enter, come have a look through what people have made and vote for the ones you like.

Would be great to get a few more people from Reddit involved before it closes.

And a massive thank you again to everyone who has already entered. Some of you have put a stupid amount of work into these and it has been really cool watching it come together.
